preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The input contains exactly m unique edges with no duplicates.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (len(A) > 0 and len(B) > 0 and set(A).isdisjoint(set(B)) and all(any(u in A or v in A for u, v in edges) and any(u in B or v in B for u, v in edges)) and output_format_valid)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output two non-empty disjoint sets A and B where both are vertex covers; otherwise output -1. The output format must strictly follow the specified structure.
The output is -1 if and only if no pair of disjoint non-empty vertex covers exists for the given graph.
